title: NarrativeTrace skill frontmatter
description: The YAML frontmatter of a SKILL.md in the NarrativeTrace skills catalogue. `name` and `description` are the Agent Skills open standard's own fields; everything NarrativeTrace adds lives under `metadata`, which the standard leaves free-form. Additional top-level properties are allowed because the standard owns that namespace (`license`, `allowed-tools`, fields it may add); `metadata` is closed because NarrativeTrace owns it and an unrecognized key there is a typo, not an extension.

name.description: Directory name of the skill and the standard's identifier. Lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens; 64 characters is the standard's ceiling.

description.description: What agents match on. Carries the trigger phrases the user actually types, quoted verbatim. 1024 characters is the standard's ceiling.

metadata.description: NarrativeTrace's additions to the standard's frontmatter.

tier.description: Tier of the capability the skill wires. A `pro` skill reached from a free install states what it delivers, what it needs and where to get it — it never pretends the capability is present.

ports.description: Ports where the capability exists. A skill whose ports exclude the host project's language states so in an Availability section before its first step.

verify.description: The command the agent runs as its own definition of done. Always the port's own gate for the capability, never a checker written for the skill.

version.description: Version of the artifact this catalogue was generated from. A mismatch against the installed library means the catalogue is stale and must be regenerated.
